name: Japan

seo.title: Japan Travel Guide: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima & Nara
seo.description: Plan Japan travel with city guides to Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima and Nara: temples, castles, food, UNESCO sites, tips and itineraries.
seo.h1: Japan Travel Guide: Five Essential Cities

heading: Japan Travel Guide: Five Essential Cities
description: Japan combines ancient temples, shrines and castles with modern cities, technology and food culture. This content set features Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima and Nara, which together cover imperial history, Buddhist and Shinto heritage, merchant culture and modern peace history.

Kyoto and Nara are especially important for traditional architecture, Buddhist art, Shinto shrines, imperial history and UNESCO heritage. Japan’s official tourism information highlights Kyoto, Nara, Hiroshima, Tokyo and Osaka among its major destinations.
The cities are linked by an efficient high-speed rail network, which makes multi-city trips simple.

quickFacts.Entry: Visa rules depend on nationality; check Japan’s official foreign ministry sources
quickFacts.Best time overall: Late March–April (cherry blossoms) and October–November (autumn colours)

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in Japan
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.intro: Tokyo developed from the former Edo castle town into Japan’s political, economic, technological, fashion and entertainment capital.
cities.knownFor: Modern capital, shrines, museums, technology, food

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.intro: Kyoto was Japan’s imperial capital for more than a thousand years and remains the country’s leading centre for traditional culture, gardens, tea ceremony, crafts, temples and historic neighbourhoods.
cities.knownFor: Temples, shrines, gardens, geisha districts, UNESCO monuments

cities.name: Osaka
cities.intro: Osaka developed as a commercial and merchant city and is known for food, entertainment, shopping, modern architecture and its historic castle.
cities.knownFor: Street food, Osaka Castle, nightlife, theme parks

cities.name: Hiroshima
cities.intro: Hiroshima is known for peace education, modern reconstruction, islands, gardens and regional food.
cities.knownFor: Peace Memorial Park, Atomic Bomb Dome, Miyajima

cities.name: Nara
cities.intro: Nara was Japan’s capital from 710 to 784 and contains some of the country’s oldest Buddhist temples, Shinto shrines, palace remains, sculpture and wooden architecture.
cities.knownFor: Ancient capital, Todai-ji, deer, UNESCO heritage
